version.changelog:
🎉 Initial Release
First public release of the AgentLens skill for AI coding assistants.
✨ Features
- Codebase Navigation - Teaches AI agents to navigate large codebases using agentlens docs
- Progressive Disclosure - Core skill + references loaded on-demand
- Multi-Platform - Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI compatible
- Token-Efficient - Navigation patterns with 80-96% token savings
📦 Structure
agentlens/
├── SKILL.md              # Core instructions
└── references/
    ├── navigation.md     # Navigation patterns
    └── structure.md      # .agentlens/ explained
🔧 Install
agentlens skills install
📋 Platforms
- Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/agentlens/
- OpenCode: ~/.config/opencode/skill/agentlens/
- Codex CLI: ~/.codex/skills/agentlens/
---
Links: GitHub (https://github.com/nguyenphutrong/agentlens) · Docs (https://github.com/nguyenphutrong/agentlens#readme)

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agentlens
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is benign. It consists solely of markdown files and a metadata JSON, with no executable scripts or code. The markdown files provide instructions to the AI agent on how to navigate and interpret a specific documentation structure (`.agentlens/INDEX.md`, `modules/{slug}/MODULE.md`, etc.) for codebase understanding. All instructions are informational and workflow-oriented, guiding the agent's reading and comprehension process, and do not contain any malicious commands, data exfiltration attempts, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection designed to subvert the agent's core purpose or access unrelated sensitive data. The mention of a `agentlens` command in `SKILL.md` is an instruction for the agent's potential external actions, not a command executed by the skill itself.

llm.summary: This skill is a small code-navigation guide that reads local AgentLens documentation and does not install software, persist itself, or request unusual authority.

dimensions.detail: Local file reading is expected for a codebase-navigation skill, and the guidance encourages selective reads rather than broad or unrelated data access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown instructions and references only; no executable scripts, dependency installation steps, remote payloads, or install-time behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to navigation and code-understanding workflows; the 'always start' language is broad but coherent with the skill trigger and does not attempt to override safety rules or unrelated user goals.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill mentions regenerating docs with an agentlens command if docs seem stale, which could update local project documentation, but it is purpose-aligned, disclosed, and not automatic.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is codebase navigation through .agentlens documentation, and the instructions only direct the agent to read project maps, module summaries, outlines, memory notes, imports, and selected source sections.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should understand that this skill will steer the agent to trust and read .agentlens files in a project before source files. That is appropriate for navigation, but those files are still project content and should be treated with the same caution as repository documentation, especially before regenerating docs or acting on warnings from memory.md.
